provenance: Each observation is explicitly classified as PURE_XNA_DERIVED metadata or RUBY_MAPPING_QUALIFICATION; never CNA output
derivation: Foundation 26 DisplayModeCollection. The contract row comes from the pinned public metadata and docs/generated/xna-il-inventory.json. The mapping row encodes what the pinned Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Graphics.dll IL establishes: GetEnumerator walks the backing list in order, and Item[format] walks it in order collecting every mode whose Format equals the argument into a materialised list. IEnumerable`1 and IEnumerator`1 project to fresh Ruby Enumerators, as mapping-rules.json already required, and Ruby Enumerable is deliberately not mixed in.
